defect_type.instructions: What caused the damage in the customer's warranty claim?

criteria.manufacturing: A fault in how the product was made or a part failed in normal use
criteria.wear: Normal wear from use over time
criteria.accident: Dropped, hit, spilled on or misused
criteria.unclear: The claim and photo do not show the cause

photo_shows_damage.instructions: Does the photo description in the claim show the damage the customer describes?
